summary.implementedScope: Resolved verifier finding S5-001 only. In src/cli/view.ts, `view pull` now prints the message array itself as JSON on stdout on success (the AC-5.5/TC-5.4 contract: the array IS the product, not an OpResult envelope), and `view materialize` prints the written path itself on stdout. Both commands fall through to the existing renderResult on failure, so every failure case still exits nonzero with the structured OpResult error JSON (missing-thread and unknown-format legs unchanged and still passing). status, compact, and sweep are untouched and keep printing the SDK result JSON, preserving their parity coverage. The --help blurb names the two success-output exceptions. cli-process-view.test.ts now asserts the story contract directly: the pull parity leg and the CLI-advance leg parse stdout as a ViewMessage[] and compare it to the SDK pull's messages; the materialize leg asserts stdout.trim() equals the --out path before validating the file. Manifest hash re-recorded for the modified process test; both gates rerun green.
